title: Fully-faithful X.509 enrollment over 1-hop TSCH (PKCS#10 uplink + runtime DER downlinks)

test.description: All three enrollment flights are X.509-sized. Client (node2) POSTs a real PKCS#10 DER CertificationRequest on /sen (c509_csr_to_pkcs10_der -> x509_encode_csr); server (node1, CA/root/coordinator) parses it with the minimal secp256r1 PKCS#10 parser (x509_csr_parse), verifies the PoP over the CertificationRequestInfo, issues a C509 Type-2 cert, and returns both /crts and /sen as runtime-reconstructed X.509 DER. Proves the full X.509 enrollment round-trip on-device (no static blobs, no mbedTLS in the enroll link).
